items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And John Field (PHONETIC). >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, John -- [INTERVIEWER] He was a character. He had a face painted on his bass.

ctx.x: Was Fats staying in that part of the country?
Yeah, he was staying in Cincinnati at the time. He had a show at WOLW called the Rhythm Club.
Which was taken from the Rhythm Club up here in Harlem. And I mean it was named after that you know. And he had a kind of act on there. That's when the first time the INK Spots got to be known.
